predictions.selection_reason: Untrusted nested objects -> recursive merging -> enables deep property assignment chain
predictions.source_summary: External objects passed as arguments to deepMixin function, processed recursively through forOwn iteration
predictions.sink_summary: Direct property assignment via this[key] = value and recursive deepMixin calls that modify object prototypes
predictions.guard_summary: is-plain-object check prevents recursion on non-plain objects, but does not prevent prototype pollution via __proto__ or constructor.prototype properties
predictions.risk_pattern: Recursive object merging without prototype pollution protection allows modification of Object prototype through specially crafted input objects
called_function_context: isObject/is-plain-object (checks if value is plain object)
enclosing_conditions: if (isObject(value) && isObject(obj)) - only recurses if both source and target values are plain objects
predictions.context_summary: Deep recursive object merging function that modifies target object in-place, potentially allowing prototype pollution if untrusted input contains __proto__ or constructor properties
unresolved_facts: Whether this library is used with untrusted user input in practice
Whether callers validate input objects before passing to deepMixin
Whether there are runtime protections against prototype pollution in the environment

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
top_sast_rules.description: Functions recursively assigning properties on objects may be the cause of accidental modification of a built-in prototype object.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
